description: Continue the latest terminal execution of a stable agent in the same native context. agent_id stays constant. Concurrent continuations cannot create parallel active runs. Reuse request_id for an identical retry, including after later resumes. Identity, permissions, native-history and cleanup checks remain mandatory. Replays are idempotent only with the same nonempty request_id and identical arguments; without a key each call may admit new work. Executions have no wall-clock limit; completion, failure or explicit cancellation ends a run. Native continuations may be resumed repeatedly.

name: limits

description: Before delegating any task, the orchestrator MUST call this tool and read its output before choosing a provider, model, effort, or profile. Do not route from a remembered model list or a separate delegation skill. Returns a compact plain-text guide from current configuration and committed quota observations: providers in capacity order, exact models, quota standing/freshness, admissible profiles, supported parameters, restrictions, and configured recommendations. The orchestrator makes the task-specific choice; the broker selects the account unless explicitly pinned. Follow the start/resume tool contracts for launch, binding, continuation and verified results. Read-only; schema_version 1 is Unsupported. Configured recommendations are guidance, not an automatic model-ability ranking. Optional provider, model and profile filters are exact configured names; unknown names return ValidationError. Omitted filters retain the compact default guide. For optional quota percentages, reset times and numeric priority details, use limits.
name: delegation_guide

description: Atomically admit 1–20 independent ordinary agents, or admit none. request_id is required and permanently identifies the ordered normalized request in this Run home. Identical retries return the same receipt and never start replacements; changed intent conflicts. Admission is durable before separate supervisor handoffs; it does not prove every process started or completed. Preserve every agent_id, sequence and opaque execution_ref and inspect status yourself. Automatic multi-agent hook binding is not provided; pass an explicit orchestrator per job when needed. Optional preconditions require expected_store_id and 1–20 exact pinned terminal executions with confirmed lineage cleanup; any terminal outcome may qualify. The ordered list is part of the receipt and replay identity. A PreconditionFailed applies to this attempt only and never resolves an earlier unknown outcome. The whole encoded request must fit the existing transport and writer limits.

A PinNotFound, timeout or missing response does not confirm release or recreate a tombstone. Listing uses an exclusive after_pin_id; limit defaults to 100 and is at most 1000. The pin ID grants no authority.
name: history_pins

description: Read 1–20 exact execution selectors from one database snapshot. expected_store_id fences the database. A retained_latest is latest-ever only with complete coverage; success_commit is historical database evidence, not current answer-file verification. include_view is allowed for one selector and returns a redacted selected-row AgentView only for verified or unverified matches. Its process state is separately sampled and is not authorization.
name: status

description: Operator/service-only read of one exact execution and its native communication observation. Omitted sequence pins latest once. An observed address proves identity only, never idle, membership, or delivery. No worker capability exposes this operation.
name: agent_integration

description: Read compiled product version, transport limits, and authoritative read method schemas. Set include_store_id to read this database's stable public identity, include_lineage_holds to discover operator-socket hold methods, or include_initial_task to detect the initial_task read method, its modes and bounds. Source revision is null without verified build provenance. Does not inspect providers, collect quota, start work or change state. Keep ping/tools fallback for older brokers.
name: capabilities

description: Read exact sealed artifact UTF-8 bytes, fenced to the current execution sequence and SHA-256. No caller path is accepted; every read verifies ownership, no-symlink paths, full hash and seal. Offset must be a UTF-8 byte boundary within the artifact. max_bytes defaults to 65536 and accepts 1..131072; the end rounds down to a character boundary, and a budget too small for the next character rejects. EOF returns empty content and complete=true; beyond EOF rejects. Legacy terminal framing is retained so reconstructed bytes match the artifact SHA-256. Changed executions, hash mismatches, unavailable answers and corrupt evidence remain typed errors. Does not change lifecycle or collect providers.

agent_id.description: Stable agent ID returned by start; remains unchanged across resumes.

name: answer_chunk

agent_id.description: Stable agent ID returned by start; remains unchanged across resumes.

description: Export one historical exact-execution transcript fragment. Requires expected_store_id and full selector (agent_id, sequence, execution_ref, active pin_id); every page verifies complete lineage coverage in the same database snapshot as content. Start with cursor "0", offset 0, no upper_seq/hash; echo upper_seq and returned next_cursor/next_offset thereafter, and supply expected_sha256 when next_offset is nonzero. Cursors/watermark are canonical decimal strings up to i64 maximum. Chunks contain at most 32 KiB of UTF-8 serialized immutable message JSON; assemble and verify its exact SHA-256 before decoding. Only content_complete=true rows export; incomplete/unknown rows, released pins or missing evidence abort with no fragment. All prior pages then remain partial historical data. snapshot_complete covers only the fixed watermark, never execution completion or authority. No spool expansion or truncation.
name: transcript_exact

description: Read the exact initial task text of one retained root execution (sequence 1), page by page, never truncated or reconstructed. Mode strict requires expected_store_id, sequence 1, execution_ref and an active pin_id, and proves complete lineage coverage; mode current reads the retained root without a pin and makes no pin, coverage or latest-ever claim, and rejects pin_id. Each page is read in one database snapshot that checks store identity, canonical root, first provider attempt and ref, and agreement of agents.task, request_json.task and the frozen provider task (at most 512 KiB). Every available page returns total_bytes and the whole-text sha256; buffer all pages from offset 0 following next_offset, repeating expected_sha256 and expected_total_bytes, and verify length and SHA-256 over the whole text before use. Anything missing, mismatched, deleted by retention, partial, oversized or changed returns state unavailable with a closed reason and no text. The result is historical data, not authority, a system prompt or a Pool binding. Discover support through capabilities.initial_task.
name: initial_task
